item.title: US Envoy condemns 'Israeli' airstrike on Syrian airbase
item.description:
US Envoy to Syria Tom Barrack accused Israel of carrying out airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur Airbase in Syria, calling the strikes an “unnecessary escalation" that does not advance regional stability. Israel has not acknowledged the strike.
Barrack said the Al-Sharra government has not adopted a “predatory posture" or maintained proxy forces, and has repeatedly indicated a preference for de-escalation with Israel. He said the US would continue to host discussions aimed at encouraging diplomacy over military action.
“The United States continues to believe that restraint and engagement offer the more constructive course," Barrack said, urging all parties to prioritize dialogue over further military incidents.

item.description: Trump threatened Oman amid concerns over its Iran ties as Washington seeks a nuclear deal with Tehran and the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: FBI report: Jews account for 64% of US religion-based hate crimes
item.description: FBI data shows Jews remained the most targeted religious group in US hate crimes in 2025, accounting for 64% of religion-based incidents.

item.title: Complaint alleges brutal Border Police violence and theft
item.description: A new complaint accuses Border Police officers of assaulting a minor, using gas at protesters, and allegedly taking a credit card during the evacuation of the Tel Talpiyot outpost.

item.title: Bank Leumi files lawsuit against Meta over fake bank scams
item.description: Bank Leumi sues Meta for NIS 26.6 million, alleging Facebook and Instagram allowed fraudulent ads impersonating the bank and targeting customers.

item.title: Rabbi Yuval Cherlow reflects on soldier’s return after 44 years
item.description: After 44 years of uncertainty, Rabbi Yuval Cherlow reflects on the identification of Yehuda Katz’s remains, describing a moment of profound pain, consolation and renewed hope for his family.

item.title: Police foil alleged ISIS attack plot targeting Be’er Sheva nightclub
item.description: A 20-year-old Negev resident is indicted for allegedly planning an ISIS-inspired attack on a Be’er Sheva nightclub and seeking to join the terror group in Syria.

item.title: Negev resident arrested for planning terror attack in Be'er Sheva
item.description:
The Israel Police and Shin Bet arrested a resident of the Negev who is suspected of having contact with a foreign agent, possessing weapons, and planning terrorist activity and an attack in Be’er Sheva.
The State Attorney’s Office filed a serious indictment against him this morning.

item.title: IDF kills Islamic Jihad commander involved in Oct. 7 abduction
item.description: IDF eliminates Islamic Jihad commander Tareq Anwar Khamis Ra'i, who infiltrated Kibbutz Be'eri on October 7 and took part in abducting an Israeli civilian.

item.title: Interceptor launched at false target near Lebanese border
item.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target in the area of Zar'it.
No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.
There is no risk of a security incident. The incident is under review.
